title: Four Students Stole Britain's Coronation Stone 🪨
caption:
True story. On Christmas Day 1950 four Scottish students took the Stone of Scone out of Westminster Abbey. It officially went home to Scotland in 1996. 🪨
Would you have pulled it off? 👇
first_comment: Four students beat the security of Westminster Abbey. Genius or just lucky? 🪨👇
